reviews.text: Dr. Daniela, Dani, is not only a lovely person but also a fantastic professional! She took care of my golden retriever Alfredinho during his first years! In fact, she saved our puppy's life by quickly identifying tick-borne disease and starting treatment! We are very grateful! Dr. Daniela also taught us a lot about Alfredinho's dietary discipline! I highly recommend her and am very grateful!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Excellent experience at Allegra Pet! I was very satisfied with the service, the care, and the attention from the entire team. Attentive, competent professionals who are truly concerned about the well-being of our pets. Everything was done with great professionalism and dedication. I recommend them without hesitation! 🐾❤️

I love this place! The atmosphere is excellent, the professionals are exceptional, and the service is always impeccable.

Olivia's baths are always done with great care and attention. During one of her baths, the groomer noticed a lump and made sure to let me know. Dr. Dani attended to me promptly, and we were able to identify and resolve several problems with my dog ​​in the same week. Thank God everything was resolved, and today Olivia is healthy and doing great.

All of this shows how skilled, attentive, and genuinely caring the team is about the animals. It's a level of care that makes all the difference.

Congratulations on your work! I am very grateful for all your care, dedication, and availability.
Bath and grooming, great!!

For the past 4 months, we have been treating our son João with Dr. Daniela. He has a complex condition in his digestive tract, and we will be eternally grateful for her availability, attention, and care for him.
Even though we don't live in Brazil, we continue the treatment remotely because we trust the doctor and her team!

Dr. Daniela is an excellent veterinarian. We had the microchipping procedure done on my two dogs, it was super easy and she gave us valuable tips! Now we're going to proceed with the procedures to travel to Europe with them safe and sound! I highly recommend her!!
A place with a team of excellent veterinarians, offering professional, differentiated, and highly qualified service.

Excellent pet shop, with a wide variety of options for dogs and cats, amazing bathing and grooming, with a super helpful, respectful and approachable team, and to top it all off, the veterinarian Daniela was sensational, taking great care of my pets!!! It's my favorite pet shop and veterinarian!

They are amazing! The best my baby has ever had in her 11 years of life, so far. Dr. Dani, Guilherme, and the entire team, without exception, are very caring and professional. Tootsie arrives and leaves happy. When she has an appointment with Dr. Daniela, she goes to the doctor's office all excited. I love Pet Allegra.
The service is organized and excellent! It's where I always take my pet for baths, grooming, nail trimming, and brushing!

The best of all Pets!
Marilu LOVES this clinic, I can't even go for a walk on the street without her dragging me there! She even loves taking a bath 😂.

Thank you so much for always taking such good care of my little one, especially during "emergency" visits, when Marilu eats things she shouldn't and then gets sick. Lots of licks to the whole team. 💕

Excellent, very excellent! I had Amanda who was very well cared for for 17 years by Dr. Dani and the whole team. Now I have a Shih Tzu, almost 5 years old, who has been a client here since he was 50 days old. He loves going to the pet shop. The advantage of Allegra Pet is that they have doctors in all areas. Luke has already had 3 dental surgeries. He's had ophthalmological exams, in short, everything is great. I love it!

I took my dog ​​for a scissor trim, which was paid for in advance, and unfortunately I had a disappointing experience. Even with some knots in her fur, there was no careful finishing touch, the cut was uneven and poorly done. In addition, what worried me most was her behavior when she got home: trembling, scared and totally different from her usual state. She is not playing, she seems uncomfortable and insecure — something that had never happened before.
Unfortunately, I do not recommend the service. I expected more care and sensitivity towards the animals.

My pet had his first bathing experience, where I was warmly welcomed along with Theodoro. I informed them that I was recovering from a illness, and they were attentive to his difficulties. I highly recommend them for the attention given to his bath, the guidance from the veterinarian present, and the warm welcome from everyone on the team 💙🐶
The service was very good.

I learned about Allegra through a recommendation from a couple of friends. Since then, I only have praise and gratitude for the entire team. The service is welcoming from the reception onwards, and the grooming staff are extremely careful and always very kind. At the veterinary clinic, my Chico, a young senior Maltese, is cared for by Daniela and Catarina, professionals who listen carefully, are extremely didactic, and answer all the owner's questions. I have already had some surgical procedures performed there, such as castration and gallbladder removal, both performed by Hayashi under Daniela's supervision, and Chico's recovery was exceptional.

I recommend them both for the grooming service and for the veterinary consultations and exams. The entire Allegra team is very welcoming, attentive, and always looking to offer the best for the pets.
When we have an elderly dog, all we look for is a place that offers comprehensive, reliable care and provides peace of mind. Allegra Pet is that place. I certainly recommend it.
Excellent clinic, thank you for taking care of our four-legged children with so much affection and love!!!

We've known Dani since we moved to the neighborhood and have been coming here regularly ever since, both for veterinary checkups and for grooming with scissors. Dani is extremely professional, and our dog loves coming here, including for medical exams required for international travel. We always recommend her!!

Wonderful experience. I've been taking my pets there for years, the service and the professionals are excellent!
I highly recommend it.
The professionals are always very attentive, and the environment is welcoming and very well-structured.
Take very good care of my Caquinho! ❤️
Allegra Pet is excellent, both the pet shop and Dr. Daniela. I've been taking my dog ​​there for years and have always been very happy.

I love this clinic, it's undoubtedly the best in the region. The reception is quick and helpful, the veterinarians are super competent and attentive, and they treat my pets with special care! The treatments offered are modern and effective; my 17-year-old cat can attest to that – he's living a great life thanks to the dedication of these professionals in overcoming the difficulties and challenges of geriatrics.
I've been bringing my children here for 3 years now, I moved but I still come. Best pet shop in the area 😍 …
Excellent service! Everyone was very helpful and attentive!
Highly personalized and attentive service at all times!

Super welcoming environment, both at the clinic and the pet shop.
Everyone is very attentive and helpful!
Dr. Daniela is a highly experienced professional who always takes care of my pets with great affection and attention!
I took my Shih Tzu to get groomed. It was such a relief to find a groomer who could trim the grumpy little creature. I recommend them.

I have complete confidence in Dr. Daniela and her entire team; they are all very competent and attentive. They have been taking care of my children for over 15 years, and everything has always gone well. They've even become like family to me. THANK YOU Dani and Guilherme!!
